title: Composition identity for the specified forward cartesian unit-cohomology map
statement: Let k→kprime be a commutative-ring algebra map, f:C→Spec k, and h display a cartesian square Cprime with projections iotaprime and fprime [def-pc-base-change]. Set d=h.isoPullback.hom, M=(O_C)_{kprime}, and e=pullbackObjUnitIso(baseChangeFst f). The forward map L=unitCohomologyPullbackLinear(baseChangeSnd f,fprime,d,hd,M,e.hom followed by unitToPushforwardObjUnit d,n) [def-pbc-unit-cohomology-pullback-linear] satisfies L(H.baseChangeLinear(f,O_C,n)(x)) equal to ordinary structural pullback of x along iotaprime for every x∈HOver(f,O_C,n) [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison]. This is an equality for a specified map, with no existence or bijectivity conclusion.

source.place: cohomology-equation-functorial; exact inverse-image action on Ext, and Mathlib adjunction and unit pullback APIs

proof.text: Unfold the two defined linear cohomology maps. Sheaf.H.mapFunctor_map moves the coefficientUnit for the first projection through inverse image along the cartesian isomorphism. Combine the two H.map applications with Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply. Apply structuralUnitCoefficient_comp to replace the composite coefficient morphism with invImageComp followed by the structural coefficient map for the composite.

Apply Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply and inverseImageCohomology_comp to identify successive inverse-image actions with the composite action. Finally h.isoPullback_hom_fst identifies the composite with iotaprime. The coefficient lemma is proved in this delivery; only the degree-independent inverse-image cohomology composition theorem remains open.

proof_origin.place: Original two-step route: a proved coefficient identity and inverse-image cohomology functoriality, combined by explicit naturality, H.map composition and cartesian projection equality.
